name: road_boulder

interaction.note: south (bottom) side, facing north; the push rolls the boulder east to its resting spot

note: place on a 3-tile-wide dirt road (both 96x64, one scale/palette, bottom-aligned; swap image + collision). `collision` = closed state (full road width, all 3 tiles). Closed paint is wedged mossy stone across all three tiles. Open is split: road_boulder_open.png = east resting stone (Y-sorted on boulder_bbox bottom y=56); road_boulder_open_ground.png = dirt/passage decal drawn at MAP priority under Kaela so the ground never paints over her.
